::: {.project-card}
### [Braess's Paradox in Sport](https://bleonardi.github.io/Braess_Paradox_Sports/)
Does a numerical disadvantage in hockey or soccer ever produce *more* efficient scoring output? Nine NHL seasons reject the hypothesis with high confidence; soccer remains underpowered and directionally inconclusive across four competition strata.

::: {.tags}
[Sports Analytics]{.tag} [Network Theory]{.tag} [R]{.tag}
:::
:::

::: {.project-card}
### [Census Exploration: Tri-State Spatial Analysis](https://bleonardi.github.io/Census_Exploration/)
Exploratory spatial analyses and visualizations using ACS 5-year estimates for Ohio, Kentucky, and Indiana. Choropleth mapping, interactive Leaflet maps, and demographic profiling via tidycensus.

::: {.tags}
[Census]{.tag} [Geospatial]{.tag} [R · Leaflet]{.tag}
:::
:::

::: {.project-card}
### [Population Projection Using a Variety of Approaches](https://oki-data.shinyapps.io/dynamic_projections/)
Neighborhood-level population forecasting for the OKI region using dynamic linear models, gradient boosted models, and Hamilton-Perry methodology. Interactive Shiny application.

::: {.tags}
[Demography]{.tag} [Forecasting]{.tag} [R · Shiny]{.tag}
:::
:::

Spatial models and machine learning on Landsat imagery for population estimation. Remote sensing methods course project.
